lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: guramukhaa man parateet hai gur poorai naam samaanee ||1||
lines.translation: The minds of the Gurmukhs are filled with faith; through the Perfect Guru, they merge in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mere mai har har kathaa man bhaanee ||
lines.translation: O my mind, the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, is pleasing to my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਨਿਤ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har kathaa nit sadaa kar guramukh akath kahaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Continually and forever, speak the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har; as Gurmukh, speak the Unspoken Speech. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਢੰਢੋਲਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai man tan khoj dha(n)dholiaa kiu paaeeai akath kahaanee ||
lines.translation: I have searched through and through my mind and body; how can I attain this Unspoken Speech?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਣਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t janaa mil paaiaa sun akath kathaa man bhaanee ||
lines.translation: Meeting with the humble Saints, I have found it; listening to the Unspoken Speech, my mind is pleased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: merai man tan naam adhaar har mai mele purakh sujaanee ||2||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name is the Support of my mind and body; I am united with the all-knowing Primal Lord God. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur purakhai purakh milaai prabh mil suratee surat samaanee ||
lines.translation: The Guru, the Primal Being, has united me with the Primal Lord God. My consciousness has merged into the supreme consciousness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadabhaagee gur seviaa har paaiaa sughaR sujaanee ||
lines.translation: By great good fortune, I serve the Guru, and I have found my Lord, all-wise and all-knowing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਾਗ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਦੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh bhaag vihooniaa tin dukhee rain vihaanee ||3||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are very unfortunate; they pass their life-night in misery and pain. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਦੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham jaachik deen prabh teriaa mukh deejai a(n)mrit baanee ||
lines.translation: I am just a meek beggar at Your Door, God; please, place the Ambrosial Word of Your Bani in my mouth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur meraa mitr prabh har melahu sughaR sujaanee ||
lines.translation: The True Guru is my friend; He unites me with my all-wise, all-knowing Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੩॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak saranaagatee kar kirapaa naam samaanee ||4||3||5||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary; grant Your Grace, and merge me into Your Name. ||4||3||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਾਉ ਲਗਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bhaau lagaa bairaageeaa vadabhaagee har man raakh ||
lines.translation: Detached from the world, I am in love with the Lord; by great good fortune, I have enshrined the Lord within my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਊਪਜੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil sa(n)gat saradhaa oopajai gurasabadee har ras chaakh ||
lines.translation: Joining the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, faith has welled up within me; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I taste the sublime essence of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਭਾਖੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sabh man tan hariaa hoiaa gurabaanee har gun bhaakh ||1||
lines.translation: My mind and body have totally blossomed forth; through the Word of the Guru's Bani, I chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man piaariaa mitraa har har naam ras chaakh ||
lines.translation: O my beloved mind, my friend, taste the sublime essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur poorai har paaiaa halat palat pat raakh ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Through the Perfect Guru, I have found the Lord, who saves my honor, here and hereafter. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਖੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam dhiaaeeai har keerat guramukh chaakh ||
lines.translation: Meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; as Gurmukh, taste the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਬੀਜੀਐ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan dharatee har beejeeai vich sa(n)gat har prabh raakh ||
lines.translation: Plant the seed of the Lord in the body-farm. The Lord God is enshrined within the Sangat, the Holy Congregation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit har har naam hai gur poorai har ras chaakh ||2||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is Ambrosial Nectar. Through the Perfect Guru, taste the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਮਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਬਹੁ ਲਾਖੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh trisanaa bhar rahe man aasaa dah dis bahu laakh ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are filled with hunger and thirst; their minds run around in the ten directions, hoping for great wealth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਦੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin naavai dhrig jeevade vich bisataa manamukh raakh ||
lines.translation: Without the Name of the Lord, their life is cursed; the manmukhs are stuck in manure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਭਾਖੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: oi aavahi jaahi bhavaaeeahi bahu jonee duraga(n)dh bhaakh ||3||
lines.translation: They come and go, and are consigned to wander through uncounted incarnations, eating stinking rot. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: traahi traahi saranaagatee har daiaa dhaar prabh raakh ||
lines.translation: Begging, imploring, I seek Your Sanctuary; Lord, shower me with Your Mercy, and save me, God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਪੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਖੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)gat melaap kar har naam milai pat saakh ||
lines.translation: Lead me to join the Society of the Saints, and bless me with the honor and glory of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਖੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam dhan paaiaa jan naanak guramat bhaakh ||4||4||6||
lines.translation: I have obtained the wealth of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; servant Nanak chants the Lord's Name, through the Guru's Teachings. ||4||4||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 4 ghar 5 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Fourth Mehl, Fifth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har bhagat bhare bha(n)daaraa ||
lines.translation: Devotional worship to the Lord, Har, Har, is an overflowing treasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh raam kare nisataaraa ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh is emancipated by the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jis no kripaa kare meraa suaamee so har ke gun gaavai jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: One who is blessed by the Mercy of my Lord and Master sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਬਨਵਾਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har kripaa kare banavaalee ||
lines.translation: O Lord, Har, Har, take pity on me,

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har hiradai sadaa sadaa samaalee ||
lines.translation: that within my heart, I may dwell upon You, Lord, forever and ever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਛਡਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam japahu mere jeeaRe jap har har naam chhadaavai jeeu ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my soul; chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, you shall be emancipated. ||1||Pause||
